title: docs(skills): objectstack-data's security rules name the risk of renaming or removing a shipped access item in a later version
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

It adds a risk note to `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, the access-control rules of the published data-modelling skill: **renaming or removing a shipped access item in a later package version can quietly undo an administrator's choice on upgrade.**

Administrators act on a package's permission sets, positions, sharing rules and capabilities by name. They switch items off, clone sets, and reference the package's objects and fields from their own sets. So in a later version:
- a **rename** makes the old switch-off stop matching, and the renamed item arrives switched on;
- a **removal** leaves a customer's clone or own set naming something that no longer exists;
- an **added field deny** on a shipped set is not carried into a customer's clone.

The note asks authors to keep shipped names stable and, when such a change is genuinely needed, to say in the release notes what an administrator should re-check. It is guidance only: no gate and no behaviour change. This is the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-23: 「这种应该写到元数据应用的开发规范中」「提示风险就行」.

## Why here

This came out of objectstack-ai/cloud#3173 (ADR-0126 wall 3 on cloud's install paths). The only package on the cloud marketplace is first-party (HotCRM), so the maintainer chose a development-convention note over a runtime check or a publish gate.

## The token budget

The file sat at its ratchet ceiling, so the new text is paid for by deleting restatements in the same file. No rule changes meaning. Each deletion:

1. **The RBAC stack-key bullet.** The "`permissions`, not `permissionSets`" fact is the code sample's own comment just above it.
2. **"takes the set's `name`".** This repeats the sentence above it.
3. **The assignment payload.** It repeats the columns listed two sentences earlier.
4. **The `view_pii` sample's comment.** It repeats the sentence directly above it.
5. **The `viewAllRecords` corollary.** It follows from "it never crosses the Layer 0 wall" in the same bullet.
6. **The callout tail.** It restates the two Layer 0 bullets and the recipe's AND-gate comment; the ADR-0095 D1 citation stays in the first bullet.

The changes were written at the tier that `dispatch-gates.mjs` mandates for `skills/**`.

## Verification

Run on head `3d46b7b8`:
- `check-skills-token-ratchet`: `security.md` is 2541 / 2543 tokens; `--self-test` passes.
- `check:doc-authoring`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:role-word`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:corpus-claim-drift` and `check-doc-route-spelling --advisory`: each exits 0.

**Noticed, not touched:** the assignment paragraph still says an `organization_id` of `null` means every organization context. Since #24583 step 7, an organization-less grant confers nothing, so that clause looks stale. Fixing it changes a rule, so it is left for its own change.
